description: Public polls on Power Players: the question, its type (shape: single, multi, statements for agree/pass/disagree, or ranked; lengthKind: pulse, running or custom), who started it (origin 'site' means it was started by PowerPlayers on a cited news topic: source gives that article's url, title, publisher and date; site polls count real member votes only), the place, n (how many members answered: the sample size), closesAt and closed. Results follow the site's rule: option counts and percentages (and agree/pass/disagree counts for statements) appear only once a poll has closed; open polls show n only. status is 'active' (default), 'completed' or 'all'; filter by a two-letter state (that state's polls plus national ones), a five-digit county FIPS or a Census place id. Votes come from members who chose to answer: not a scientific or representative poll and never split by party, so never present a result as public opinion.
name: list_polls
title: List polls
